t: What he was given while they thought he slept
a: نَهْرٌ وَعَدَنِيهِ رَبِّي عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ عَلَيْهِ حَوْضٌ
m: A sūrah was revealed to me just now, and he recited: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. Indeed We have given you al-Kawthar. Then he asked: do you know what al-Kawthar is? It is a river my Lord has promised me in Paradise, over which is a basin.
